observations.statement: A fixed finite library of constant-size equivalent gadgets cannot be amplified through a polynomial-size acyclic circuit context into superpolynomial Krajicek rewrite distance: Circuit Frege proves equivalence bottom-up with constant cost per DAG gate, and R038 yields a polynomial chain.

Exponentially many occurrences in an unwound formula do not imply an exponential Circuit-Frege proof when they arise from polynomial DAG sharing; the proof can reuse one equivalence line per shared gate.

For every fixed radius R, explicit 2-CNF SAT and UNSAT formulas exist with exactly equal rooted signed-incidence neighborhood multisets through radius R; componentwise XOR parity supplies the opposite labels.

Exact local-type equality does not determine global bounded-treewidth decision behavior: the H118 pair has treewidth two, while a global dynamic program distinguishes whether the two marked XOR edges occupy the same component.
H115 is unusable under both readings: with H114's universal obstruction included it is circular, and with only local-twin premises it is refuted by H118 and the identity compiler.

Every positive SAT list with distinct witness set A is covered by a globally SAT-sound circuit that ORs fixed-assignment evaluators; H116 must therefore exceed the explicit witness-cover size and still defeat semantic compression.

A surviving locality obstruction now needs two global resources absent from H115: high input treewidth to exclude identity and a theorem forcing every low-treewidth local output to factor through a common quotient that loses the decisive lift parity.
After C017, the expected inventory is 104 live hypotheses and 16 terminal historical nodes; inventory remains a bookkeeping quantity rather than a completion percentage.
